sources.title: open-audiovisual generic layout
sources.note: No single fixture behind it: a common channel order, written by hand. Read the manual of your light and, where its order or ranges differ, copy this file and change it before patching a real fixture. The strobe ranges say open and strobe but no Hz: a generic file cannot know how fast a given value flashes, so under the 3 Hz cap the engine keeps this channel open. Without a faster cap set on purpose, this light works as a plain white flood.
